errors.text_span: 最大的切片为“中国典籍与文化”，占比67%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the largest slice (67%) as belonging to "中国典籍与文化". According to the legend, "中国典籍与文化" corresponds to a dark green color and a much smaller slice (likely 1-2%). The 67% slice is a large teal slice whose specific journal name is not immediately clear from the legend's color coding, but it is definitively not "中国典籍与文化".
